name: Lily - Boom Chakra Lacka (Deck Guide)
description_md:
***Some friends and I have been playing a lot of lily recently including an hilarious "tripple dragon" run of the fan made [Consternation on the Constellation](https://www.printerstudio.co.uk/sell/designs/consternation-on-the-constellation-uk.html) using 3 very different Lilys decks (and flaunting unique ID rules!). This deck is essentially the culmination of a lot of our shared experience from that and a few other games. I borrow a lot from their ideas, so a quick shout out to @Neramoor @Turbinismo, and @mattastrophic.*** I thought I would post this guide ahead of the presumably imminent wider Edge of the Earth upload since almost all of the main cards i want to talk through are already up. The only one not listed is [In the Thick of It](/card/08125). This lets you start with 3xp in exchange for 2 trauma. Take 1 of each. The deck is by no means comprehensive or as heavily tested as some of my older decks. I am really just trying to give people a few ideas and principals to help with their own. [Alchemical Transmutation](/card/03032) can be any cheap spell to get [Dragon Pole](/card/08060) going early if needed. Ive just picked the cheapest I could find, and more cash is rarely bad. Pick what you like. Ive not tested it, but to my surprise I have my eye on [Wither](/card/05157) for another fight action. Occasionally lowering test strength follow up attacks might be handy. ***some experiences:*** I can confirm that she is an absolute blast to play and she has a ton of viable and varied archetypes to explore. She is a bit of a powerhouse, possibly a bit above curve, but so long as you know that going in its fine, and it can be fun to play a ringer once in a while, not least one that has such a thematic feel. The no firearms restriction on her deck building seems to be genius making all but the most convoluted build make thematic sense in an over-the-top kung foo movie way. *(EDIT: A lot of people have been kindly PMing me to point out that i have put* ***two disciplines on the list when you can only start with 1. This is intentional*** as you basically pick one then grab the other later. There are more ***details in the CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER section***. *However as I know not everyone reads the guides in full, i thought i would leave a note. Thanks to all for letting me know though. Its useful to know when things arnt clear.* _-_
-------<<<<<>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***RUSH HOUR!*** *(TL:DR)* ***OVERVIEW:*** * CLUEING: ....................... Low, but options for higher * ENEMY HANDLING: ...... ***Chuck Norris with Fireballs***. * ENCOUNTER PROT: ...... High * DRAW CONSISTENCY: .. Sufficient * CASH ENGINE: ............... Sufficient * HEALING: ....................... High (self only) ***PLAYSTYLE:*** * ROLE: ............................. Primary Damage Dealer, * COMPLEXITY: ................ Moderate * JANK FACTOR: ............... Some Nuance, not a lot. * THEMATIC FEEL: ........... High Octane Kung Foo Spell Blade. ***SLOTS:*** * **Hands** ............. [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093)/[Dragon Pole](/card/08060) + [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261). * **Accessory** ...... [Holy Rosary](/card/01059) (+) * **Body** ............... [Bandolier (2)](/card/51001) (+) * **Arcane Slots** .. [Sixth Sense](/card/05158), [Fireballs](/card/60407)/[Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) * **Tarot** ............... *unused* * **Allies** ............... [David Renfield](/card/03112), & [Nephthys](/card/07262) (+). *A high damage, mixed melee and spells Lily deck with a combination of reusable 2-4 damage melee attacks, and massive burst turns utilising the on [the Discipline](/card/08014a) to clear out gluts of enemies, and/or [Big Bosses](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0067824/?ref_=tt_urv).* * is stacked high enabling spells for clueing or combat spells, and added to when using [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093), [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261), and [Spectral Razor](/card/06201). Alternatively the spells themselves in arcane slots boost the [Dragon Pole](/card/08060). These circumvent the need for [The discipline](/card/08013a) until later campaign leaving access to the stronger (in this build) abilities on the [the ](/card/08014a), and [ disciplines](/card/08011a), and easing the transition between level 0 mystic and level 1-5 guardian builds.* *Later campaign, [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093) with [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) adds this TWICE to the test massively overshooting the bag and almost guarenteeing landing 3 above for [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093)s a whopping 4 damage attack once a turn, without ammo management concerns.* *The burst damage from [the ](/card/08014a) should not be underestimated. Even with limited use for this is an MVP Ability that starts in play. It will usually be 2 of: A weapon hit, [Spectral Razor](/card/06201), [an arcane slot attack spell](/card/60407), or [Clean Them Out](/card/60111) (for cash); then a basic attack using a skill card for draw. Reasonably hitting 2 x 2damage attacks and a 1 damage attack from early campaign which is plenty for 2 or 3 enemies, or big one. Mid-Late campaign it can build to 2 literal [Hammer](/card/08093) [Blows](/card/07261) and 1 other thing for a reusable 8-11 ish damage any time you can reset it.* *Just remember to shout HADOUKEN! when using an upper cut into a [fireball](/card/60407).* *(There is a reason we didnt bring [Shrivelling](/card/01060) even if it is arguably better once we grab [Empty Vessel](/card/06277)!)* _-_
-------<<<<<>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***WAKE ME UP BEFORE THE DOJO*** *(Upgrades)* ***PRIORITIES:*** * **[Stick to the Plan](/card/03264)** -Ok I know you want the hammer, but it is overkill early campaign, and STTP adds so much consistency and tempo to our "big rig" set up that you need a good reason not to grab it first. See the muligan section, but all its targets are big first/second/third turn plays that you will see a lot of value from. OOOR if like me you are [easily amused](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jgN69nqXuU) by things like this, ["Get over here!"](/card/60123)s can also go on it ;) * **1x [Alchemical Transmutation](/card/03032) [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261)** - Its arcane slot has synergy with the [Dragon Pole](/card/08060) and is cheap and accessible earlier if you dont have the full 5xp spare for a hammer. * **Grab the [Cyclopean Hammers](/card/08093) as and when you have a full 5xp** Replace [Enchanted Blade](/card/05118) first, then 1 [Dragon Pole](/card/08060). ***ALTERNATIVE WEAPON OPTIONS:*** *There are a few alternatives if you dont fancy the hammer, or you want something more thematic (Is Lilly playing golf not thematic enough for yo... yeah ok)* * **[Holy Spear](/card/07302)** I wont go into it here for space reasons, but there is definitely a viable looking bless build that uses a similar will heavy shell. One of my early attempts can be [found here](https://arkhamdb.com/deck/view/1652218). Because [Holy Spear](/card/07302) has 2 different fight s on a single card, our ability on [the discipline](/card/08014a) can be used to trigger 2 of them, with the 3rd being a basic attack setting up power turns early so long as [Someone](/card/07001) is also spamming blesses, also see related note below about [Holy Rosary(2)](/card/07220) and [Nephthys](/card/07262). * **Lilyanrdo! [Butterfly Swords(2)](/card/08025)** - Also has synergy with [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261), using the + boost on the first attack to land it, and the boost on the second gets you 4 damage once a turn. At 6xp cheaper for 2 sets vs the hammers its definitely a candidate, especially if you are building to more of a hybrid build where you may have other xp priorities. * **Donatelily! grab the second [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) early**, and stick with the [Dragon Pole](/card/08060). Synergy with the pole already noted, if you are taking this route. I will leave someone else to work out the many arcane slots build options from the lvl0 mystic pool. Guardian has some [nice armor](/card/07189) stuff too for a shell. jus sayin. * **Raphaelily. Ok we cant have Sai, but any two daggers would work** [Survival Knife (2)](/card/53002) could be solid with some dodge/soak stuff... * **DEAR MAXINE WHERE ARE THE GDM NUNCHUCKS!** *....AAAaannnnnnyyywwwaaaayyyy.....* ***LATER OPTIONS:*** * **[Empty Vessel](/card/06276)** You will be killing a lot of enemies so this will charge up fast. Late campaign token cancelling can be really nice especially on hard/expert, but also note that by zeroing the token, a [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093) blow will now almost definitely be 3 above test even if you didnt have the [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) on it yet. If (you are dead to me and) brought [Shrivelling](/card/01060) in place of [Azure Flame](/card/60407), it can also stop the horror. (If you brought it AS WELL AS fireballs I forgive you). * **[Holy Rosary (2)](/card/07220) & [Nephthys](/card/07262)** Shout out to Neramoor who I have seen make good use of these 2 alone in a similar build. [The Rosary](/card/07220) is enough to get a few tokens circulating while [Nephthys](/card/07262) keeps them play, or lets you ping damage as a finale. Crucially because you mainly want the reliable/cheap +2 boosts, the blesses building up is just a nice incidental bonus and can be added to any deck irrespective of [Holy Spear](/card/07302) variants. * **[Overpower (2)](/card/60126)** Always an option - More draw is just nice. * **[Vicious Blow (2)](/card/02299)** Similarly always an option, importantly this doesnt compete with the 5 lvl0 guardian slots which is the only reason [VB(0)](/card/01025) didnt make the campaign start. * **[Police Badge](/card/01027)** If you have not seen [Samurai Cop](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0130236/trivia) please watch it after reading the first trivia note in the link. This is one of my favourite moments in film history and I watch a lot of bad films. Nevertheless, the option to turn that boost into 2 actions later game when you have less use for it is nice... But mainly do it to reminisce about the hair. The rosary is probably better in most cases. _-_
-------<<<<<>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER!*** *(Discipline Selection)* Start with one of these and aim to get the other ASAP: * **[The Discipline](/card/08011a): +1, : heal 3 hp for 1 direct horror or visa-versa,** Recommended first for 2p, or any group where you plan to help with clues. This makes you a lot tougher and helps land spells (Also see clue section for variants), * **[The Discipline](/card/08014a): +, : Spend 3 different fight or evade s.** Recommended as first in 3-4p groups where you are primarily focussing on damage and others are cluing. See combat section for why this is the best damage boost option here. [In the Thick of It](/card/08125) lets us start with 3xp, so we only need 12 more before its available. This is probably after ~sc2 in most campaigns - ie not long. Get [the Discipline](/card/08013a) (+1 : +5 skill to next test) next. This is deferred because the passive doesn't matter much when you have huge +skill built into weapons, plenty of skills we want to spam for draw anyway, and spell options running off . [The Discipline](/card/08012a) (+1 : big draw effect) is last priority as were not really using the stat, and the ability is great but hard to reset (at least in this build). _-_
-------<<<<<>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***ENTER THE DAGON!*** *(Mulligan)* **[Stick to the Plan](/card/03264) Targets:** * [Prepared for the Worst](/card/02184) *Didn't see a weapon? - get one* * [Ever Vigilant](/card/03023) *Everyone's favourite guardian set up button.* * [Clean Them Out](/card/60111) - *May not be obvious. This can be one of the ability on [the Discipline](/card/08014a) for easy early money even if the attack doesnt land for the damage.* **Then** mulligan for 1 combat asset, [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093) by preference, or [Dragon Pole](/card/08060) with 2 spell assets to get a reusable +1 damage. [Azure Flame](/card/60407) also works. After that look for cash and draw, ideally 3 assets if [Ever Vigilant](/card/03023) is available, remembering you can play [Prepared for the Worst](/card/02184) turn 1, then [Ever Vigilant](/card/03023) turn 2 from [STTP](/card/03264). _-_
-------<<<<<<>>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***NINJITZ-CLUE*** *(Clues)* *No surprises here* * **Stack High** We have a lot of assets for this: [Holy Rosary](/card/01059), [David Renfield](/card/03112), [Bandolier (2)](/card/51001) (note that all primary weapons in this build are 2 handed to get the boost) * **There are plenty of icons while setting up** [Guts](/card/01089), [Uncage the Soul](/card/03033), or [Promise of Power](/card/07032) all work. you could even get a single clue on a lower shroud with a [Promise of Power](/card/07032) alone by pushing to 6 . * **Then use [Sixth Sense](/card/05158)** This could be any clue spell. I chose it not becasue it never runs out, but because you can use lower shrouds on symbol tokens, meaning it sometimes becomes that little more viable that little bit earlier. In large groups you arnt likely to use this that often, so something like [Clairvoyance](/card/60408) for the extra clues would be fine. OR if you want a more clue heavy build, just bring both and sacrifice [Alchemical Transmutation](/card/03032) and one of the damage tools. _-_
-------<<<<<<>>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***CHEN-LI!*** *(Enemy Handling)* *You should not be short of combat options without phenomenal bad luck.* * **Prioritise getting a melee weapon down first** as a reliable and reusable damage option. [Prepared for the Worst](/card/02184) can find it. [Ever Vigilant](/card/03023) can play it (and others) cheap. Hence the STTP setup. * **[Azure Flame](/card/60407) or [Spectral Razor](/card/06201) can be used until you find one.** If you don't have the boosts in play yet, use skill cards to land it. Note the double icons on [Uncage the Soul](/card/03033), and that [Daring](/card/06111) can be used on any fight action, including ones. * **Early campaign while using [Dragon Pole](/card/08060),** note the arcane slots on [Enchanted Blade](/card/05118) and [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261). These are extra ways of getting the up and getting to the +1 damage, the former needing the bandolier in play however. * **Start building up extra Fight options to enable the [ Discipline](/card/08014a).** Remember a basic fight action can be one of the Actions, as can [Clean Them Out](/card/60111) from [Stick to the Plan](/card/03264), so as soon as you have any other attack, you have one 3 part burst available. Don't hold one shots back. Late game you will have multiple fight assets in play and wont need them to get to 3. * **Remember [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) is a spell** [Uncage the Soul](/card/03033) can be used to play it if you need cash. Its not an asset even though it feels like it however so [Ever Vigilant](/card/03023) cant play it. * **As is [Spectral Razor](/card/06201),** which can be used as an opener to engage aloofs, or enemies on comrades. Just remember, If using uncage on [Spectral Razor](/card/06201) while engaged you will take an attack of opportunity as playing uncage is a non fight action even if it later initiates one. Still... You have a lot of healing so it can be fine. * **[Daring](/card/06111) and [Promise of Power](/card/07032) can be used to evade** you have 4 base , these take you to 7 and 8 respectively if needed. This is especially handy on massive boss enemies allow others to avoid attacks of opportunity and move out or just not get attacked at end of round, or just to mitigate retaliates. Evade as first action on a play. Note that the discipline flips AFTER you complete the 3rd action so you have the for the actual tests. *Right! onto the good stuff!* ***COMBOS AND FUNNSIES*** * ***HADOUCHEN!!*** it is compulsory to shout this when using [Azure Flame](/card/60407), and as everyone knows, the fire ball should be the last action in a set as the opponent is slowly falling backwards through the air unable to block. * ***[LILYHAMMER!](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1958961/)*** With the [Cyclopean Hammer](/card/08093) you are usually aiming to be 3 above on 3 hp enemies. The combo with [Wish Eater](/card/06277) is already noted in the upgrades section, and the combo with [Enchant Weapon](/card/07261) is simply that by adding your boosted twice to the test, you should overshoot the bag so much that you either deal 4 damage or miss by . * ***CROUCHING TIGER WOODS HIDDEN DAGON!*** The knockback on [The Hammer](/card/08093) is rarely that useful as you normally just kill things, but you can push a non hunter into an empty location and just leave it there if you need to. OOOOR you can combine this with [Righteous Hunt](/card/07109) to launch an enemy across the board for a free move.... The latter is a terrible idea overall but you do get to play Golf, and you do get to shout ***"FOOOUURRRRR"*** as that is exactly the amount of damage dealt when an enchanted hammer lands the 2 location push back! _-_
-------<<<<<<>>>>>>-------
_-_ ### ***HEX ON HEX OFF*** *(Encounter Protection)* *No Surprises here. Just a lot of good stuff in the right places that are mostly also needed for progressive tools:* * **High will go a long way on encounter checks** This is usually associated with horror on fail effects, thoug we are seeing more variety these days. You also have plenty of pips if needed in a pinch. * **4 isnt bad** With [Wish Eater](/card/06277) you can get moderate odds on a pass as a cancelled token has no modifier so it will pass you on tests upto 4. You can also use [Promise of Power](/card/07032). * **[Ward of Protection](/card/01065)** Does what it says on the tin. Heal back the horror if needed. or use it to kill off [David Renfield](/card/03112). * **Heal back with [the Discipline](/card/08011a)** Its slow, but does the job that so many 2 cost 1 shot heal events do by netting you 2 health or san. With the new weaknesses that came out in Edge this is particularly helpful. Though you will also eventually get [Wish Eater](/card/06277) too. Any time you can reliably heal, you can take risks on tests that do small harms. If you pass by chance you lost nothing. If it hits you, then you can heal. _-_
-------<<<<<<>>>>>>-------
_-_
*As ever, Thanks for reading! Have fun!*
